name: The Orgrimmar Legion Needs Mojo!
label: Quest
description: The Orgrimmar Legion Needs Mojo!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Orgrimmar Legion has put in a request for several unusual ingredients. Given their current performance in Silithus, we'd like to comply with their request as soon as possible. Gather the materials and bring them to the troll called Shai.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have my materials, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, yes. Just what I needed! I'll make a special concoction with this. The silithid won't like it one bit!
